ac1.command:
set -u
# ac1 - the re-premise is EXACTLY ONE 64-byte literal: byte-diff proof against
# the FIXED milestone base blob 06be1e1:backend/scripts/docs_verification.py.
# Run from the repository root. Read-only.
command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo "ac1 RED: python3 missing"; exit 1; }
d=backend/scripts/docs_verification.py
test -f "$d" || { echo "ac1 RED: $d missing - run this fence from the repository root"; exit 1; }
# Blob read convention (t79 ac4): WSL git first, cmd.exe git as the fallback,
# because a worktree whose .git gitlink holds Windows-form paths is readable
# only through cmd.exe. Both sides are CR-normalised before hashing, because
# core.autocrlf=true makes the working copy CRLF while the blob is LF.
blob() {
  o=$(git show "$1" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  if [ -z "$o" ]; then
    g=$(wslpath -w "$PWD")
    o=$(cmd.exe /d /c "git -C $g show $1" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  fi
  [ -n "$o" ] || { echo "ac1 RED: blob $1 unreadable through WSL git AND cmd.exe git"; exit 1; }
  printf '%s\n' "$o"
}
BASE=$(blob 06be1e1:backend/scripts/docs_verification.py)
[ -n "$BASE" ] || { echo "ac1 RED: the fixed base blob could not be read"; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$BASE" > /tmp/t100_ac1_base.py
tr -d '\r' < "$d" > /tmp/t100_ac1_work.py
python3 - /tmp/t100_ac1_base.py /tmp/t100_ac1_work.py <<'PYAC1' || exit 1
import hashlib, re, sys
STALE = "6e9723e84f91259b200af63490abfb431636d61a07e201f14052c7353807a249"
TARGET = "09cb7d9adbabd424c4d0517c0b899cad0fd650486ec2e08f1e99615c4c5850d6"
base = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
work = open(sys.argv[2], "rb").read()
def fail(m):
    sys.stderr.write("ac1 RED: " + m + "\n"); raise SystemExit(1)
# 1. the base is the pre-fix state this card was groomed against
if base.count(STALE.encode()) != 1 or base.count(TARGET.encode()) != 0:
    fail("the 06be1e1 base blob is not (stale once, target zero) - the premise of this card has drifted and the card needs a re-groom, not a guess")
# 2. the ONE constant: exactly one INDEX_ANCHORS entry for key 133, identity t26, digest TARGET
entries = re.findall(rb'^\s*(\d+): \("([^"]+)", "([0-9a-f]{64})"\),$', work, re.M)
keys = [e[0].decode() for e in entries]
if keys != ["16", "54", "131", "132", "133", "135", "215", "216"]:
    fail("INDEX_ANCHORS carries %d entries %s - not the 8 measured at groom (16,54,131,132,133,135,215,216); an entry was added or deleted, which is RELAXATION, not re-premise" % (len(entries), keys))
hit = [e for e in entries if e[0] == b"133"]
if len(hit) != 1:
    fail("the anchor table does not carry exactly one tests[133] entry")
if hit[0][1] != b"t26":
    fail("the tests[133] anchor identity is %r, not t26 - the identity half of the anchor must not move" % hit[0][1])
if hit[0][2].decode() != TARGET:
    fail("the tests[133] anchor digest is %s - not the as-shipped entry_sha %s" % (hit[0][2].decode(), TARGET))
lineno = [i + 1 for i, l in enumerate(work.split(b"\n")) if re.match(rb'^\s*133: \("t26", ', l)]
# 3. the constants this card must NOT have touched
for const, want in ((b"INDEX_FLOOR", b"217"), (b"README_LINES", b"396")):
    m = re.search(rb"^" + const + rb" = (\d+)$", work, re.M)
    if not m or m.group(1) != want:
        fail("%s is %s, not the measured %s - this card owns ONE constant" % (const.decode(), m.group(1).decode() if m else "missing", want.decode()))
if not re.search(rb'^README_DIGEST = "15b244135126b7051a1601b773b966d698b7ac50898d8da959a8fe59abfe3e20"$', work, re.M):
    fail("README_DIGEST moved off the measured 15b24413 triple pin - this card owns ONE constant")
if len(re.findall(rb'"[0-9a-f]{64}"', work)) != 13:
    fail("the script carries %d quoted 64-hex literals, not the 13 the base carries (tests[258] pins this count; a single-value replacement may neither add nor remove one)" % len(re.findall(rb'"[0-9a-f]{64}"', work)))
if STALE.encode() in work:
    fail("the stale pre-t90 digest still occurs in the script - the re-premise did not land")
if work.count(TARGET.encode()) != 1:
    fail("the target digest occurs %d times, not exactly once" % work.count(TARGET.encode()))
# 4. byte-diff proof: one contiguous 64-byte span, length-preserving, lossless both ways
if base.replace(STALE.encode(), TARGET.encode()) != work:
    fail("the working copy is NOT the 06be1e1 base blob with exactly one stale->target substitution - something else moved")
if work.replace(TARGET.encode(), STALE.encode()) != base:
    fail("the substitution is not lossless in the reverse direction")
if len(base) != len(work):
    fail("the working copy is %d bytes, the base %d - the edit is not length-preserving" % (len(work), len(base)))
diff = [i for i in range(len(base)) if base[i] != work[i]]
if not diff or diff[-1] - diff[0] + 1 > 64:
    fail("the differing bytes are not confined to ONE 64-byte window (n=%d, width=%d) - more than the pinned literal moved" % (len(diff), (diff[-1] - diff[0] + 1) if diff else 0))
sys.stdout.write("ac1 evidence: base blob sha256 %s (513 lines, 20443 bytes) -> working sha256 %s; INDEX_ANCHORS keeps all 8 entries (16,54,131,132,133,135,215,216) and the tests[133] entry sits on line %d; INDEX_FLOOR=217, README_LINES=396, README_DIGEST=15b24413, 13 quoted 64-hex literals\n" % (hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest()[:12], hashlib.sha256(work).hexdigest()[:12], lineno[0]))
sys.stdout.write("ac1 GREEN: SINGLE-CONSTANT RE-PREMISE PROVEN - the working script IS the fixed 06be1e1 base blob with exactly one 64-byte literal swapped (stale 6e9723e8 -> as-shipped 09cb7d9a) at offset %d, byte-identical outside that span in BOTH directions, anchor identity t26 and all eight anchor entries intact (re-premise, not relaxation, not deletion)\n" % diff[0])
PYAC1
rc=$?
rm -f /tmp/t100_ac1_base.py /tmp/t100_ac1_work.py
exit $rc
ac1.note: PASS rc=0, run VERBATIM from the repository root at the live tip (tree bytes identical to the product commit eae5978 since the tip commit a9b74c7 is docs-only). Independently re-extracted fence bytes from the card first. Evidence: base blob 06be1e1 sha256 19ed105a95fb (513 lines, 20443 B) -> working sha256 788b89dab25ba03a8ac56013607b587a873f5ef2746c0aa27b3d6b61c6ef7f50 = the groom-measured candidate; ONE 64-byte literal swapped at offset 1937, byte-identical outside that span in BOTH directions, length-preserving; INDEX_ANCHORS keeps all 8 keys (16,54,131,132,133,135,215,216), tests[133] identity t26 and digest 09cb7d9a on line 46; INDEX_FLOOR=217 (line 36), README_LINES=396, README_DIGEST=15b24413, 13 quoted 64-hex literals; stale digest 0x, target exactly 1x.

ac2.command:
set -u
# ac2 - the generator is GREEN on this tree and the committed report is
# byte-stable generator output carrying the real tokens. Run from the repo root.
# Writes ONLY docs/criteria/docs_verification.md (which this card owns as
# generator output) - everything else is read-only.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
r=docs/criteria/docs_verification.md
d=backend/scripts/docs_verification.py
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac2 RED: python3 missing"; exit 1; }
command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac2 RED: uv missing - the canonical invocation is (cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/docs_verification.py)"; exit 1; }
test -f "$d" || { echo "ac2 RED: $d missing"; exit 1; }
test -f "$r" || { echo "ac2 RED: $r missing"; exit 1; }
n=$(mktemp) || { echo "ac2 RED: mktemp failed"; exit 1; }
t=$(mktemp) || { echo "ac2 RED: mktemp failed"; exit 1; }
u=$(mktemp) || { echo "ac2 RED: mktemp failed"; exit 1; }
# CRLF discipline (t98 precedent): git checkout normalises this worktree to CRLF
# while the generator emits LF, so every comparison below is CR-stripped on BOTH sides.
tr -d '\r' < "$r" > "$n"
# --- W2 pollution gate, PRE-RUN. The generator's LINK_CHECK leg walks EVERY
# *.md in the tree (os.walk minus SKIP_DIRS={.git,node_modules,.venv,
# __pycache__,dist,staging}), so its files= token is a function of untracked
# scratch, not of the product. Do NOT hardcode a count: derive the walk set from
# `git ls-files` (gitignore-aware, so .venv/.pytest_cache/scratch are excluded)
# and require the run to happen on a tree with ZERO untracked *.md outside
# docs/state/ and docs/issues/ (the two prefixes LINK_CHECK itself skips).
# Measured anatomy: 265 tracked *.md at bfc46f2; 266 with a stray
# backend/.pytest_cache/README.md; 2933 in a scratch-polluted main worktree.
g=$(wslpath -w "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$PWD")
lsf=$(cmd.exe /d /c "git -C $g ls-files" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
[ -n "$lsf" ] || lsf=$(git ls-files 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$lsf" ] || { echo "ac2 RED: no tracked-file list from git (neither cmd.exe nor WSL git) - the walk-set superset cannot be established"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
tracked_md=$(printf '%s\n' "$lsf" | grep -c '\.md$')
echo "ac2 evidence: tracked *.md from git ls-files = $tracked_md (the LINK_CHECK walk set; docs/state/ and docs/issues/ are skipped by the leg itself)"
st=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$st" ] && [ -z "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  # WSL git cannot read this worktree's gitlink (Windows-form paths): use cmd.exe git
  st=$(cmd.exe /d /c "git -C $g status --porcelain --untracked-files=all" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
fi
[ -n "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" ] || [ -n "$st" ] || { echo "ac2 RED: no git status from either git flavour - the pollution gate would pass vacuously, so it refuses to pass"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
untracked_md=$(printf '%s\n' "$st" | sed -n 's/^?? //p' | grep '\.md$' | grep -v '^docs/state/' | grep -v '^docs/issues/' || true)
if [ -n "$untracked_md" ]; then
  echo "ac2 RED: the tree carries untracked *.md outside docs/state/ and docs/issues/, so the generator's LINK_CHECK files= token would measure this session's scratch rather than the product:"
  printf '%s\n' "$untracked_md" | head -10
  echo "ac2 RED: remove them (or run in a clean worktree) and rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache; NEVER edit this leg to match a polluted count"
  rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1
fi
rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
# --- run 1: capture stdout (the generator prints its failing checks to stdout
# only) and the exit code, then prove the committed report equals generator output.
(cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/docs_verification.py > "$u" 2>&1)
rc1=$?
tr -d '\r' < "$r" > "$t"
if ! grep -qE '^docs_verification: GREEN$' "$u"; then
  echo "ac2 RED: the generator did not report GREEN (rc=$rc1). Its failing checks (stdout) are:"
  grep -E '^(docs_verification:|.*FAIL)' "$u" | sed -n '1,10p'
  if grep -qE '^INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=217 entries=318$' "$t" && ! grep -qE 'FAIL tests\[133\]' "$u"; then
    echo "ac2 RED: DISCLOSED ENVIRONMENT CLASS - the anchor[133] leg is GREEN and only the EXECUTED stored gates fail (tests[134] needs node + frontend/node_modules/js-yaml visible to the generator's runtime; tests[155] needs cmd.exe git, i.e. a worktree whose .git gitlink is Windows-form). Fix the RUNTIME (link node_modules; use the Windows-git worktree the orchestrator creates) - this fence refuses to pass a partially-executed gate set, because doing so would also pass a genuinely broken card."
  fi
  rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1
fi
[ "$rc1" = "0" ] || { echo "ac2 RED: the generator exited rc=$rc1, not 0"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
grep -qE 'FAIL' "$u" && { echo "ac2 RED: the generator printed a FAIL line despite GREEN"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
cmp -s "$t" "$n" || { echo "ac2 RED: the committed report is NOT generator output - a fresh GREEN run differs from the committed bytes. The difference (CR-normalised, first 20 lines) is:"; diff "$t" "$n" | sed -n '1,20p'; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
# --- the real tokens, from the generator's own output (W1): no paraphrase.
grep -qxF 'INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=217 entries=318' "$t" || { echo "ac2 RED: the report carries no 'INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=217 entries=318' line - the measured floor is 217 (NOT the 256 that a WAL note assumed) and the measured entry count is 318"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
grep -qxF 'STORED_GATES PASS executed=9 failures=0 restored=1' "$t" || { echo "ac2 RED: STORED_GATES is not 'PASS executed=9 failures=0 restored=1' - the nine re-executed stored gates are the anchor legs' execution half"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
grep -qE '^LINK_CHECK PASS files=[0-9]+ links=[0-9]+ broken=0$' "$t" || { echo "ac2 RED: LINK_CHECK is not PASS with broken=0"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
lc=$(grep -E '^LINK_CHECK PASS' "$t" | grep -oE 'files=[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
[ "$lc" = "$tracked_md" ] || { echo "ac2 RED: LINK_CHECK files=$lc does not equal the tracked *.md count $tracked_md - the walk saw scratch pollution the tracked set does not contain (delete it; do not edit this leg)"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
grep -qxF 'ALL_CHECKS_PASS' "$t" || { echo "ac2 RED: the regenerated report does not end ALL_CHECKS_PASS - the anchor[133] debt is still open on this tree"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
grep -qE 'CHECKS_FAILED' "$t" && { echo "ac2 RED: the report still carries a CHECKS_FAILED line"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
grep -qE 'anchor identity/digest' "$t" && { echo "ac2 RED: an anchor digest mismatch is still reported"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
# --- run 2: byte-stability of the committed report across fresh runs
cp "$t" "$n"
rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
(cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/docs_verification.py >/dev/null 2>&1)
tr -d '\r' < "$r" > "$t"
cmp -s "$t" "$n" || { echo "ac2 RED: the report is not byte-stable across two generator runs - the generator is hermetic by contract (no timestamps, no git metadata)"; rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"; exit 1; }
sha=$(sha256sum "$t" | cut -c1-64)
lines=$(wc -l < "$t" | tr -dc '0-9')
echo "ac2 evidence: report CR-stripped sha256 $sha, $lines lines (the base report is 54 lines ending CHECKS_FAILED 1; the +1 line is the INDEX_ANCHORS PASS row that the anchor failure had suppressed)"
rm -f "$n" "$t" "$u"
echo "ac2 GREEN: GENERATOR HONEST AND REPORT IS ITS OUTPUT - rc=0, stdout 'docs_verification: GREEN' with no FAIL line, the committed report is byte-identical to fresh generator output across TWO runs, it carries 'INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=217 entries=318', 'STORED_GATES PASS executed=9 failures=0 restored=1' and 'LINK_CHECK PASS files=$lc' equal to the $tracked_md tracked *.md walk set (W2 pre-run pollution gate: zero untracked *.md outside docs/state/ and docs/issues/), and it ends ALL_CHECKS_PASS with no CHECKS_FAILED line"
ac2.note: PASS rc=0, run VERBATIM from the repository root AFTER relocating the builder's untracked scratch/build_t100/ out of the repo (hygiene precondition; the W2 pollution gate then saw ZERO untracked *.md outside docs/state/ and docs/issues/). tracked *.md = 265; generator stdout 'docs_verification: GREEN' with no FAIL line and rc=0; the committed report is byte-identical to fresh generator output across TWO runs (CR-stripped sha256 1c7a1a293f3190773738a0eb291b5a7b9490d575186d0923ded7220e3387ac4d, 55 lines); carries 'INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=217 entries=318', 'STORED_GATES PASS executed=9 failures=0 restored=1', 'LINK_CHECK PASS files=265 links=67 broken=0' == the 265 tracked *.md walk set, and ends ALL_CHECKS_PASS with no CHECKS_FAILED line. INDEPENDENTLY re-confirmed by a generator run with OUT redirected to a scratch path (shipped report never written by that measurement): byte-equal, sha 1c7a1a293f31...

python3 - <<'PYAC3' || exit 1

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)

    fail("the reverted constant still emitted the PASS row - the leg cannot fail")
if any("tests[133]" in f for f in nf if "133" not in f):
    fail("unexpected collateral failure: %r" % nf)

now = open(SRC, "rb").read().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
if now != shipped:

if hashlib.sha256(open(APK, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != apk_before:

sys.stdout.write("ac3 evidence: shipped-constant arm -> FAILS=%r and the row 'INDEX_ANCHORS PASS floor=217 entries=318'; reverted-constant arm -> FAILS=%r and NO PASS row\n" % (pf, nf))
sys.stdout.write("ac3 GREEN: NEGATIVE CONTROL FIRES - the SAME shipped comparison in check_index_and_stored_gates() (sha256 of the canonical JSON of tests[133] against INDEX_ANCHORS[133]) accepts 09cb7d9a and REJECTS the stale 6e9723e8 with 'anchor identity/digest'. The leg is live, not deleted, not weakened; the perturbation ran on build/t100/neg_docs_verification.py (removed again) and the shipped file and the carried report are byte-identical afterwards\n" % ())

ac5.command:
set -u
# ac5 - DELTA PURITY. Two FIXED refs, each used for what it can prove:
#   06be1e1  the MILESTONE base - the script's fixed blob (measured identical at
#            06be1e1 and at the builder's base: no card between them touched it)
#   HEAD     the builder's own base commit - the committed report and the
#            orchestrator-owned index (t99 legitimately moved the index BEFORE
#            this card's base, so the index is proved UNMOVED-BY-THIS-CARD
#            against HEAD, never against the milestone base)
# Git is called through EITHER flavour (WSL first, cmd.exe fallback) because a
# worktree's .git gitlink is readable to only one of them depending on who
# created it (the t79 ac4 precedent). Read-only. Run from the repository root.
d=backend/scripts/docs_verification.py
r=docs/criteria/docs_verification.md
P=docs/state/merge_test_index.json
MB=06be1e1
test -f "$d" || { echo "ac5 RED: $d missing - run the fence from the repository root"; exit 1; }
GW=""
gitx() {
  # WSL git first; cmd.exe git as fallback (a worktree's .git gitlink is readable
  # to only one flavour depending on who created it). Command substitution loses
  # the exit status through the pipe, so success is decided on non-empty output.
  local out
  out=$(git "$@" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  if [ -z "$out" ]; then
    [ -n "$GW" ] || GW=$(wslpath -w "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$PWD")
    out=$(cmd.exe /d /c "git -C $GW $*" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  fi
  printf '%s' "$out"
